minor.issue: Edge case: the guard only skips the empty write when EITHER a non-empty row exists for tenant+dataset OR an existing row with the same params_hash exists. If a tenant has ZERO rap_filtre_lookup rows at all (neither empty nor healthy), the first empty payload can still create a row_count=0 record. In practice this is protected by client.py which now iterates all RAP_FILTER_LOOKUP_SOURCES before push, but defense-in-depth would be to unconditionally skip row_count<=0 writes for rap_filtre_lookup, e.g. `if ($datasetKey === 'rap_filtre_lookup' && $rowCount <= 0) return ['skipped_empty_overwrite' => true];` Reference: /app/pos_entegrasyon/sync.php:440-454

Filter matches by both `Kaynak` and `KAYNAK`. This is safe, but note that client.py (line 5191-5192) sets BOTH keys on each row, so the OR is always redundant on freshly-synced blobs. Older blobs from pre-fix client versions may only have one of the two — leaving the OR is correct.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: 9 tenants had dataset_cache.data_json='[]' for rap_filtre_lookup because old client.py invoked the RAP_FILTRE_LOOKUP stored proc with an empty Kaynak parameter (the proc returns nothing when Kaynak='') and immediately pushed the empty result via sync.php, overwriting any healthy blob. E1's three-layer fix is verified working: (1) sync.php save_dataset_cache guards against empty overwrites when a healthy row exists for the tenant+dataset (lines 440-454); (2) client.py process_pending_requests now special-cases rap_filtre_lookup with empty Kaynak — iterates all 36 RAP_FILTER_LOOKUP_SOURCES (LOKASYON, PROJE, CARI, …), tags each row with Kaynak and KAYNAK, returns merged result (line 5183); (3) backend endpoint POST /api/data/report-filter-options reads the single cached blob (Kaynak='', Q='') and filters by source in Python — verified LOKASYON returns 2 rows, PERSONEL 3, FIS_TURU 37, all correctly tagged. _RAP_DENY prevents on-demand fall-through to sync.php, so if the cache is empty the endpoint returns [] gracefully (verified with tenant 6de69d3b... in <2s). Recommendation: unconditionally drop empty rap_filtre_lookup writes in sync.php (defense-in-depth) so the first write on a brand-new tenant can never install a bad blob.
